# Synthetic fixture: the "domains this organisation actually holds" list, for
# XSPEC-383 R7-c.
#
# In a real adoption this file is NOT hand-maintained. The config points at a
# `command` source instead, and that command asks the registrar or the cloud
# account — `aws route53 list-hosted-zones`, `gcloud dns managed-zones list`,
# a registrar API — so the list is read from the system of record rather than
# from somebody's memory of it.
#
# A file source is the fallback for corpora that have no such API reachable
# (this fixture, an air-gapped build). It is still checked: if the file is
# missing, unreadable, or yields zero domains, the gate exits 2. Failing to read
# the list is not the same as "the list is empty, so every domain is allowed".
#
# One domain per line; blank lines and # comments ignored; a leading "*." is
# stripped.
uds-effect-boundary.test
